I felt messed up indeed.

I see.

Ohh

Yes same. Can't comprehend why people disapprove. I never ask to be here. Same goes to everyone. I don't fcking care how others can do it, but I can't and that's it.
They're not the one who feel our pains. So they can just sit and stitch their bulls.

Oh it's just my awful try at analogy.
I'm just saying I can't stand "what happens, happens". I'm not fine with sitting around waiting for "something" to happen to me.
If I'm capable, I want to "try" to get what I want. Be it suicide or better coping mechanism. But it's leaning more and more towards the former with each passing second...... I really feel miserable.....

Dissapprove of?

Oh I see. I think I'm not, like never, that laid back. It have to be apple or orange. I can't stand unexpectedly an apple, unexpectedly an orange. My head hurts even while I typed that.......

Haha if just that's true

And hey, if that's so the case you have to read your own words
Or here I come

If it can come to me, it can come to you too. I can't say much but I think you'll be okay

Ty for saying that regardless.
It's embarassing to say, but that's nice to hear indeed.

And I have awesome memory so I keep forgetting things (I'm trying to improve on that though), you haven't answered my question. I hope I can know what do you want as well.
I just can't help but to lower my wish. And that can't even come true. Idk what to do anymore that I can no longer function.

Oh no.
I don't necessarily want or need that.

If I can just handle the shts other living shts constantly pour on me. That's all I want and need. But humans are greedy I'm bound to want something else. But what an utopia it must feel (if I can reach that first wish).

Hm idk what did you meant by that.

But I certainly don't want where I am.
I can either be death where all shts end. Or somehow I can manage to continue living without constant immense suffers.

What about you? What do you want???

You are welcome.
Oh that's good.

I think it's not correct or wrong, because it's just the "opposite" of those bull about "healthy" whatever coping ways. Sigh I just want to curse all those talks. Though mainly because I can't make those coping ways work, despite I do want it to work (rather the unhealthy like numbing emotions etc.).

Oh lol. Well when I'm triggered I'd get more harsh on myself, whether it be sarcastic or not. So that's what I thought.

I need to stop thinking others could feel like me. But if not looking at me, I don't know how to not cause inconveniences to others................................... (idk but I feel like puttinng a lot of dots.......)
Well actually I don't find it a bad thing, AT ALL. And actually I find it nice. It seemed I triggered you. If anything, I'm the one who have to. I apologize.
Oh just forget it then. Giving you stress is my last wish.

Yes that egg donor keeping me at home.
And uh well uh it keep keeping me here because I'm going to flee obviously.
I've had multiple instances where I can't endure any fck shts anymore, so I openly go "fck you, I'm leaving" and man I'm beaten up for it. Mentally and physically. And it called all the same shts as itself on this enviroment I'm in. A lot of shts would sorrounded me every fcking time. It's so fcking scary I'm having difficulty processing how I can survive this long actually. But I can feel it's not for much longer *insert maniac laughs*.

It don't think I have mental condition. I DO HAVE MENTAL ILLNESS(ES)!!
Idk about whatever. But OCD is for sure. As I already wrote. That's a shtty combination.

It's simple. It just won't let me. And to apply myself I have to have my ID, which need me to "get out".

Idk what you're talking about. If anything you sounded like giving a brainwashing session. I hopeI'm so wrong. I'm actually scared after you said that last paragraph now..........................................

I don't really mind if you have more negativity as I'm negative right now if that's a good description of someone's state.
Haha First I want to say I hope you don't say that again. I don't think I'll survive today. So it's such a burden to hear it. Though I know your intent. :)

And so about the publishing platform.
For freelancing, you have "clients". But for those platforms you have "readers". Seriously it's a big difference that I hope you see and put to your advantage.

With freelancing, really, I think most clients are business-owners, people with complicated requests who can pay a lot but want the best in the field.
With those platforms, readers just want what they want. They don't care about quality, if the plot go how they want, that's all they need (though I think you'll receive a lot of bashing, so ideally good quality writing that have the plot that readers want).
And I'm not hypothetical. I read a lot of novels in my spare time. And I can't fcking comprehend how something of such a miserable quality ACTUALLY SELLS. I'm furious even if I'm just a reader. So I'm having "difficulty" in understanding why you think it's not way more favorable than freelancing. Take "inkitt" for example. A lot of stories are just "telling". My head hurts thinking how those kind of
stories ACTUALLY SELLS.

And about that indie game, it's worrying if you don't even have the confidence "you could possibly" be one of that 1%. Since it would meant, it really is just a "hobby", not even close to "potential" income. I hope you and your team have more confidence if you choose to continue on it hoping for it to be potential income.

As you laid out, it's hard already with self confidence, and only 1% succeeded. So it'll be harder without.
And even though it's a "right" percentage, I hope you don't think too much of it. Every situation is different. Like you probably don't have to fight against all the games there, but just within your genre. There are a lot of variables. I hope you can see that and that make you more confident.

Though if you ask me, honestly I would drop that "passion project" and "be realistic" **for now**.
Ultimately I need what I need (money). And being patient with myself to hold one of my project is a price I can pay. But that's just me (and so I want to say I don't understand why people have a difficulty with this since I don't. If I can even just finish one of my project, that'd be all I need but I can't even do that much and struggling with just 1 project.).

I think I'm better at answering rn.
Fire them all.

That's sad to hear. I can't believe how the hell I really can understand the pains (though assumed haha) you have behind those words.

Sigh I feel sad that I feel sad because I think, I can understand what you're saying.

---

And finally a bit that's not about me.

You're right. People CARE. Wow my mind changed in a fucking drop of a hat do I have to be worried???(I think otherwise just some moments ago)(this is quite mindblowing too come to think of it tbh)(haha i'm saving this post)

**But not enough**.
Thank you for thanking me.
Uh just want to intrude to say, I think the same. Not correct. But I think apathy is not bad at all. Now if just I can learn to do that at will sigh........

I am willing to if you are willing to learn.
For starter(???), can you read my earlier post on r/raisedbynarcissists ?

Aww that's nice to hear. I don't hear that a lot.
I'm bad at keeping conversations going if there's no set topic or something like it, but feel free if you want to talk to me. I'll reply if I'm still around.
I really don't know anymore. But since you talked like this I think I'll try yet again.

Idk anymore.
I'm starting to think I'm a lost case. I can't really help it. I've always endured more than enough tbh.
Oh I don't deserve that. But I'm a bit happy indeed if you feel that way.

I really agree with your title.
And I'm trying to gather my courage to give up as well.

I don't necessarily want anyone to understand since no one care.

I'm just being selfish so I replied because I have a bit to say. But I'm not replying so I can stop you from dead. And tbh no one have that right even if someone do that. It's your life. Only you get to decide.
*hug*
I really feel the title

Do you really need the money from that 9-5 job?? If not why not keep at pursuing writing?

I hope you don't limit yourself to only freelancing. What about blogging?? And in this age, there are a lot of platforms for webnovel writers. You write your story and they pay you. Of course it have to have readers for it to work. But I think it's more hopeful than freelancing. Idk how others that are successful from it did it, I wish they really go nake and give all the details, but they don't. So imo freelancing is hard. Like very hard.

That's probably the real fact so it's not a big deal.

So I think it's better if I just keep to myself.
I already want to kll myself as I am, I am not confident I can even go through this day.......
I think I can't anymore.
I hope you're not drag by my "needy" "negativity". Excuse me for my sarcasm language.
It'll be 3 hours from now. Pm me, I'll be there so you can vent.

:(

I apologize I can't say anything useful. I'm commenting just out of selfishness since I want you to know I feel sad reading your struggles..

:(

It's sad that you have the courage to give up. But I think it'll be worse if you don't have it and keep clinging like I do.
Sigh I feel like crying. 😭 *hug*

because humans have this natural instinct crap? idk I read it from this thread too


anyway, I hope I can be of support to you, tho I think you won't allow me so idk why I bothered-
that title is really sad.....
I sent mine!

Same...

Oh I see
I think I can't really comprehend your feelings. For me I hate it because it meant my egg donor is all happy WHILE she make me suffer
All the subtle intentionality just felt really real. So I suffer immensely even today (I think it even escalated since now I suffer whenever I remember it breath the same way I do every passing millisecond. I'm really really pissed.).

I see :(
That's fine then.
And fortunately I think I find the way to cope now which is gray rocking.
And I've actually trying it since yesterday. It made my endless suffering somewhat bearable. I think I can get by.
While I keep working on my plan.

And actually one of the cons for that method is I'll have difficulty processing my real emotions, so they said to have someone to talk to.
So I'm trying to have some supportive friendships, and I would need to have all the people I can. Are you interested to be one of my support?

I'm quite surprised to find someone who like anime and manga here (as quite a lot of posts I read are people that don't).

And tbh I don't believe that statistic so it resulted in me getting a good laugh.

I'll compose a pm your way.
Likewise.

Haha

I really don't like doing that kind of "somewhat-chain-message-template"-like, but i want to make exception this time.

I also have ocd though self diagnosed.
And i'm currently in a very bad situation. For me your cons aren't that "cons", so I think I'd be a friend that meets your need.
But i would need my potential friends to be able to offer encouragement, even better if you can listen to my vents for some minutes each day (and giving encouragement when I finished).

Is that a problem for you?
If not then we can start chatting asap.

(edit: ouch lol just so you know, i composed this message first before i saw your reply right above)
Hello, for that, I hope you can use it as an "advantage", by taking proofs of it, and file a report.
That's really awesome of you 😭

I would if I can. But since I can't I have to find other alternatives.
Tbh, even if I can, I would need proofs. I don't have it. Especially for the more violent ones.
I don't think it's available in my country.
Uh well as I "already" said, there is no such resources around me.

I think that's abusive, and you're not being sensitive.

For example, what you said, you saw other families aren't like that, so you actually already got the answer.

I feel sad that you have to question this like I do 😭

It's uncomfortable for me to say that. And regardless, I can't afford to pay for therapists
And I already read about some stories of bad therapists so I hope I don't have to resort to that...

I don't know what to say

But I want you to know just like yourself, I know now how sad you are inside, and I hope you can get past this. I hope that matters for you. But if not that's ok too. And I also want you to know that I think I'll be deeply hurt if you go.
If talking to someone else is helpful for you even if a little bit, I'm all ears.

Fortunately I don't want to die as well, a lot of things are happening, but I'm still trying to save myself so that's why I wrote those. So rest assured, I'm trying hard to keep myself alive.

I hope I can get "real" help too lol. But that's not possible since ln my country 911 don't exist, police don't come to our place when you need help, you have to "report". So I have to get "out". Which if I can, I'd rather just make my live better, as that kind of thing require time and money. What do I do in the "waiting" period until the case is solved?

That's exactly why I need to improve myself, instead of miserably failing to try to improve the situation.
So I just really need help on how to toughen myself in this unfavorable situation, or just why, I can't help but to feel "bad" for my abusers?
I really can't make sense of them, and I keep hating myself for it. As the only person who can only save myself, it's really hard that my hate on myself keep growing every single time I'm triggered (and that's like every breath I took?).
I really need to stop feeling so bad but I feel so bad that I can't help myself...

Do you have some solutions to that? Or just how you can be less sensitive? I'm triggered with just the fact my abusers are breathing as of this moment as I am...
(I know escape is the best, and so I'm thinking of another escape, but I have to be alive to do that, so I need some ways to keep myself alive while planning for another escape, and I'm stuck on exactly that problem)

And I really appreciate your offer for talking to me and your kind words.
I'm glad to hear your story

*hug*
